pages.text: Once you pull $(item)Mining Telemetry Logs$() from the washer, burn them onto $(item)Blank Carriers$() inside the $(item)HV Micro Burner$() to produce reusable edge chips.$(br2)Craft a batch of carriers and the burner first to close your HV water-saving loop.

The Micro Burner accepts two input tiers:$(li)$(#0E7490)Raw Log$(): 1 Mining Telemetry Log + 1 Blank Carrier → 1 Mining Edge Chip (512 EU/t × 128t).$(li)$(#0E7490)High-Purity Dataset (EV)$(): 1 High-Purity Mining Dataset + 1 Blank Carrier → 1 Mining Edge Chip at $(bold)128 EU/t × 64t$() (1/4 EU/t, 1/2 time).$(br2)High-Purity Chemical Datasets burn $(item)Chemical Edge Chips$() here too (512 EU/t × 128t).
Drop the burned chip back into the ore washer on Circuit #2 to cut water use by 90%. In EV, move on to the chemical reactor and scrubbing tower.
